name: Leadership
description: Sets strategy, approves budgets and owns the company's goals.

name: Data Engineering
description: Builds and runs the data pipelines and the warehouse that power product analytics and finance reporting.

name: Platform and DevOps
description: Runs the cloud platform, CI/CD, the API gateway and authentication; leads incident response.

name: Backend
description: Owns the core API, billing, notifications and search services.

name: Frontend
description: Owns the web app and the admin console.

name: Mobile
description: Owns the iOS and Android apps.

name: QA
description: Owns test automation, release checks and the test environments.

name: Product
description: Decides what to build and why; owns the roadmap and pricing proposals.

name: Customer Success
description: Onboards customers, runs support and owns renewals.

name: Finance
description: Owns budgeting, billing operations, cloud cost reporting and the financial close.

name: People
description: Owns hiring, onboarding and people policies.
